excerpt_lines: Use/relationship: The SEMP describes the contractor's technical approach and proposed plan
for the conduct, management, and control of the integrated systems engineering (SE) effort. It
reflects the scope, purpose, and life-cycle phase(s) of the program.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the content and intended use information for the data
deliverable resulting from the work task described in paragraph 6.3.1.4 of IEEE 24748-7:2019,
or by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
